title: Book Two · Chapter 169: The Empty Chair
story:
The reading room is open for practice after lessons on Wednesday. There are no new marks today. Students can use sample pages and ask each other questions.

Ronan sits opposite an empty chair. He puts a sample notice in front of it and reads the visitor's question aloud.

“I can come only after lunch. Can I return my packet?”

He answers from the notice. Then he asks the next question. No one sits in the chair. No one can hear a mistake or ask him to check a line.

Mei pulls the chair out.

“Does this visitor need a rest?” she asks.

Ronan moves the sample page. “You can use it.”

“We can take turns.”

He agrees. Mei reads the first question and changes one detail. Her visitor is younger than the one on the page. Ronan gives the same answer as before.

“Look at the age line,” she says.

He looks. A younger visitor needs an adult at the afternoon activity. He corrects his answer.

“Again?” she asks.

They try another question. This time, he asks about the age first. Then he explains the time and the adult rule. Mei nods and moves to the next page.

On her turn, she misses a small change in the room number. Ronan points to the new number. She draws a line through her old answer and writes the right one.

They work for half an hour. Some answers are good. Some need another look. Ronan enjoys the clear work when his eyes stay on the page.

Then Miss Wu passes their table. She asks about their practice and writes the final choice time on the board.

Next Thursday. Four students are on the present shortlist. Miss Wu will finish the record check on Monday. She will put up the final list on Tuesday.

Ronan looks at the time. He could stand here next Thursday with the new page in his hand. He could read carefully and earn one of the two places.

Mei taps their sample notice.

“Your question,” she says.

He looks down, but he cannot find his place. He starts at the wrong line.

“We already did that one.”

“Sorry.”

He turns the page. The next question is simple. He reads it once, then again. Mei waits.

After practice, she thanks him and takes her own papers. Ronan stays to stack the sample pages. Miss Wu is at the far desk. He can still go to her.

Instead, he puts the empty chair back beneath the table. Its legs make a loud sound on the floor.

“Please lift it,” Miss Wu says.

Ronan lifts the chair and sets it down gently. Then he puts on his bag and leaves before the room closes.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

sample＝练习用样例；detail＝细节；adult＝成年人；stack＝叠放。

## 理解问题

1. 和Mei互问有什么实际练习效果？
2. Ronan想到下周的机会后，注意力发生了什么变化？

## 读句子

**Mei waits.**

拆开看：Mei / waits.

Mei／等着。
